description: Search one keyword across every network at once (or a chosen subset) and get one merged, ranked list: each row normalized to platform, id, title, description, post_url, thumbnail_url, author_name, author_handle, engagement_score, stats, growth_24h, created_at, plus the network's full row under raw. sources[] says per network how many posts matched (total), so you can tell the user where the topic lives and where the corpus holds nothing (total 0 = say so, never invent posts). All words must appear, in any order. Use viralhunt_trending when the user wants ONE network with its own sorts and paging.

keyword.description: The words to find (all must appear).

time_range.description: Window on the post's own date (default 30d): a number with a unit, a bare number of days, or all.

name: viralhunt_search
